snippet.title: Runes & Revenue - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist our new Game "Runes & Revenue" now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3359700/Runes__Revenue/

Runes & Revenue is a cozy, hands-off management game where you manage your own magic shop. Recruit staff, unlock new mystical services. Strategically purchase upgrades to keep up with customer demand and ensure every adventurer leaves happy.
